Arcand C, Neumark-Sztainer D, and Hannan P conducted a longitudinal study as part of Project EAT, which examined the influence of parental eating behaviors and the home food environment on adolescents' consumption of fruits, vegetables, and dairy products. Their findings were published in Public Health Nutrition in 2007. 2. Cutler GJ, Flood A, and Hannan P explored the associations between multiple sociodemographic and socioenvironmental factors and major dietary intake patterns in adolescents. Their research was published in the Journal of the American Dietetic Association in 2011. 3.
